title: Python Data Pipeline Containerize
description: Bir veri işleme script'ini Docker container'ına taşı.

repoFiles.pipeline.py:
import json
import sys

def process_data(input_file):
    with open(input_file) as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    results = [{'id': d['id'], 'score': d['value'] * 1.1} for d in data]
    print(json.dumps(results, indent=2))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    process_data(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'data.json')
